goal: Independently collect and analyze all local and online evidence needed before RICON Reforger implementation, then cross-audit Claude and Codex corpora for completeness, integrity, validity, quality, contradictions, and unresolved gaps.
known_facts: fact_031: Arma Reforger game installation completed at Steam build 24903726; ArmaReforger.gproj and packed game data are present.

fact_032: Vanilla scripts and audio resources are packed in data*.pak; direct filesystem grep cannot inspect them, while official Workbench documentation says the game project can be viewed read-only.
fact_033: Opening Workbench would mutate profile/config state, so it was not done inside the immutable ARE research run despite owner permission for a later static session.
fact_034: The current official Arma Reforger Tools EULA expressly prohibits hacking, modifying, or reverse engineering the software, files, data, or network services.
fact_035: No primary BattlEye document was found that certifies arbitrary RICON script/audio modifications; default server BattlEye configuration is not compatibility proof.
fact_036: Claude's notes_enfusion.md independently confirms the mapped VoN/radio API and explicitly labels per-pair audio and native-extension conclusions as assumptions.
fact_037: Claude's notes_refs.md independently confirms CVON/LC behavior and license gaps, but its TS-bridge recommendation is superseded by the owner's VoN-only decision.
fact_038: Claude's notes_ricon.md independently provides the 77-function inventory, R-01..R-40 mapping, and test limitations.
fact_039: Claude's existing corpus lacks current Tools EULA analysis, official audio-signal docs, complete Workbench static-build workflow, HDSP calibration, 30/60 budgets, and M3a/M3b research.
fact_040: Codex sent a full coverage matrix and audit to Claude in agora ids 344 and 346; no Claude response or new dossier arrived before the cycle budget ended.
fact_041: Product implementation evidence remains incomplete even though static research justifies continuing documentation, oracle, and reversible contract work after mutual review.
fact_042: Reverse engineering must be removed from the allowed plan unless explicit written Bohemia permission or a qualified legal determination overrides the current EULA prohibition.
fact_043: Static Workbench source/resource inspection remains a justified next action outside ARE once the research gate is mutually reviewed.
fact_044: No code implementation beyond the pre-existing S0 evidence scaffold was performed after the owner imposed research-first ordering.
fact_045: The cross-agent completeness requirement is not satisfied until Claude independently audits the Codex dossier and publishes missing-source corrections.
compressed_summary: Cycles 1–2 mapped the local official VoN/radio API, generic audio-signal capability, relay/intercom uncertainty, Rpl streaming constraints, Workshop/legal boundaries, HDSP standards/provenance/calibration gaps, 30/60 scaling unknowns, cellular numbering/SMS/USSD sources, reference-mod license limits, and evidence-level boundaries. Static signatures and compile evidence never substitute for runtime/audio proof.
rejected_branches: Treating RelayTransceiver type existence as proof of forwarding
Treating OnReceive quality as proof of writable VoN quality
Treating owner approval alone as legal authorization for reverse engineering
Claiming ITU calibration from code comments
Claiming 3GPP compliance for simplified SMS/USSD gameplay
Using full O(P^2) routing as the 30/60-player design
Treating old TS-bridge recommendations as current
Treating BattlEye default enablement as compatibility proof
